title: DreamCo Actions Control Prospectus
truth_boundary: This prospectus describes purpose, evidence and planned value. It is not financial advice, a guarantee, or proof of benchmark mastery. Live results must come from linked repository artifacts or GitHub Actions runs.

controls.name: Run Doctor
controls.purpose: Find structural, runtime, dependency, configuration, and binding problems before deeper verification.
controls.investor_value: Reduces avoidable engineering downtime and makes repository health observable.
controls.progress: Live control surface; execution is delegated to approved local or Actions runners.
controls.planning_horizon: Minutes per diagnostic cycle; repair time is evidence-dependent.

upgrade_plan.step: Apply smallest safe repair in review branch

controls.success: Doctor completes without unclassified critical findings and preserves machine-readable evidence.
controls.fallback: Keep the finding open as observed/blocked and provide the exact evidence needed for owner review.

controls.name: Run Tests
controls.purpose: Verify repository behavior and prevent feature work from being confused with working software.
controls.investor_value: Creates auditable evidence of reliability and regression protection.
controls.progress: Tracked through repository test registry and Actions.
controls.planning_horizon: Minutes to hours depending on suite size.
controls.success: Required tests pass with no weakened assertions and artifacts are retained.
controls.fallback: Isolate failing suites and leave status blocked rather than claiming success.

controls.name: Run Lint
controls.purpose: Detect syntax, formatting, imports, type, and static quality problems early.
controls.investor_value: Improves maintainability and reduces preventable integration failures.
controls.progress: Connected to CI and Actions health where configured.

upgrade_plan.step: Separate mechanical fixes from semantic changes

controls.success: Configured quality gates pass without suppressing or weakening checks.
controls.fallback: Record exact diagnostics and route semantic issues to review.

controls.name: Security Check
controls.purpose: Detect dependency, secret-boundary, permission, and code-security risks without exposing credentials.
controls.investor_value: Protects users, intellectual property, and release integrity.
controls.progress: Connected to CodeQL/dependency/security workflows where enabled.
controls.planning_horizon: Minutes to hours depending on scan depth.

upgrade_plan.step: Classify true finding vs false positive
Patch in review branch and rerun

controls.success: No unresolved release-blocking security findings and controls remain enabled.
controls.fallback: Block the affected release path and require owner review for security-sensitive changes.

controls.name: Benchmark Locally
controls.purpose: Measure Buddy capability by quality, speed, efficiency, reliability, reproducibility, and generalization rather than task completion alone.
controls.investor_value: Provides comparable evidence for capability progress and competitive positioning.
controls.progress: Benchmark index and Actions benchmark workflows are the source of truth.
controls.planning_horizon: Minutes to days depending on suite and sample size.

upgrade_plan.step: Diagnose gap and test smallest shared repair

controls.success: A benchmark closes only when passing evidence meets its defined threshold; otherwise it remains open or blocked.
controls.fallback: Record the gap, root-cause hypothesis, and next repair experiment.

controls.name: Find Repair Plan
controls.purpose: Convert observed failures into bounded, reversible, test-backed repair plans.
controls.investor_value: Turns monitoring into continuous improvement without uncontrolled self-modification.
controls.progress: Problem Registry + bounded auto-repair policy are active on the review path.
controls.planning_horizon: Minutes for diagnosis; repair time depends on root cause.
controls.success: Repair is retained only when verification improves or preserves all required evidence.
controls.fallback: Automatically track the blocker and request owner review for high-risk classes.

controls.name: Verify Pages Data
controls.purpose: Ensure repository plans, benchmarks, health, problems, releases, and progress are represented in the public dashboard without fabricating results.
controls.investor_value: Creates a transparent public operating view of the open-source project.
controls.progress: Actions page consumes generated health/benchmark evidence; registry integration is being expanded.

upgrade_plan.step: Validate generated JSON and report files

controls.success: Every displayed metric has a traceable source and stale/unknown states remain visible.
controls.fallback: Display source-unavailable status instead of inventing a value.

controls.name: Prepare Device Bundle
controls.purpose: Validate the local launcher and release-package path before publishing downloadable Buddy builds.
controls.investor_value: Makes the project installable while preserving release integrity.
controls.progress: Download Center uses verified GitHub Release assets; native packages require successful builds.
controls.planning_horizon: 15 min–several hours depending on platform builds.

upgrade_plan.step: Publish only after release gates pass

controls.success: Only verified, downloadable artifacts are presented to users.
controls.fallback: Offer the browser/PWA route and mark native package unavailable.
